triagePolicy.rule: Rank p.148 pending candidates from same-witness OCR legibility and structural state. Promotion requires sufficiently stable evidence from ALC1737 itself; OCR is not treated as direct facsimile authority and no secondary witness may silently supply the transcription.

compact_primary_ocr_high_yield.reason: Compact same-witness OCR units are the highest-yield direct-facsimile targets.

wrapped_but_locally_legible.reason: Guide/form evidence is locally coherent but crosses OCR line breaks or hyphenation and should be visually reconstructed before promotion.

guide_or_form_materially_ocr_damaged.reason: Primary OCR damage is substantial enough that normalization without direct visual evidence would risk inventing a historical reading.

structural_undersegmentation.reason: Both candidates are pending and undersegmented; boundary and transcription must be recollated together.

nextPassOrder.rationale: Highest expected return per direct facsimile inspection.
Text is broadly identifiable; direct work is mainly line and microstructure reconstruction.
Direct visual evidence is necessary before any textual strengthening.
Requires simultaneous boundary and textual recollation.

epistemicGuards: This queue changes no transcription and promotes no article.
Same-witness OCR is evidence but is not equated with direct visual collation of ALC1737.
The 29 pending candidates are candidate-level article starts and are not automatically equivalent to 29 missing historical articles.
No precision, recall, or F1 value is claimed while the p.148 visible-start census remains non-exhaustive.

provenance.method: Conservative prioritization of every current p.148 pending_promotion candidate from same-witness OCR legibility and known candidate structure.
